critical_code_review_comments: App.js Documents component is self-contained and clean; no issues found.

window.print() is called via setTimeout after switching kind — works, but console shows browser rate-limits back-to-back print calls ('Ignoring too frequent calls to print()'). Not blocking; only surfaces when tests toggle print buttons rapidly.

Anne (mother) info block has no data source in the student model — all fields render as dots placeholders. Intentional per spec (veli fills by hand), but if a mother_* schema is desired later, model would need extension.
